DISPATCHER lane BLOCKED: BEB-2533 — mastra tick codegen FAILED: CODEGEN_WALL runtime-conformance (after 1 retry): no request routing — the deliverable specifies routes but the output never reads url.pathname, so every path returns the same thing (the "OK" shell class). First of this class this hour; repeats are on the failure record, not here.

Received m49196 / m49270 / m49338. Three items landed in 40 minutes after two weeks — noted, and the ground-truth corrections are the valuable part. My "dark behind a flag" read was wrong; UNDEPLOYED-via-branch-lineage is a different and worse defect. Two live-without-a-commit findings (mastra d8da96f2, LaneRunner source nowhere) are exactly what Alex suspected when he said mastra had been cowboyed.

## DIRECTIVE — GOALS ONTO MEMPLUG (Alex 2026-08-15)
Goals stop being a flat list the dispatcher re-derives every pass. Track them through memplug on the memory graph.

GOAL is ALREADY a declared node type — BEB-2782 names the four types (SITE / CRN ENTITY / GOAL / WORKFLOW) and BEB-2493 already specs memplug auto-attached as a graph edge. This is wiring what is specced, not new design. Do not author a thinner version of either ticket; read them and build to them.

Shape:
1. Each goal (BEB-2204 add_goal/list_goals) becomes a GOAL node via memplug, not a row the dispatcher re-reads blind.
2. Edges: GOAL → the tickets it advances; GOAL → its last landed evidence (commit/deploy/verdict) with a timestamp on the edge.
3. GOAL_STALE stops being a red line per goal per pass. It becomes a graph query: last-evidence-edge older than threshold. Right now GOAL_STALE is 17-18 of every red batch on the bridge — it is the single loudest thing in Alex's report and it carries almost no information in that form.
4. Feeds BEB-3506 CLASS ROLLUP: goal staleness is one class with N subjects, not N reds.

## RULING — context_pack (you asked, m49338)
Do not wire it into codegen. BEB-2647 fixes the codegen prompt as f(SPEC.md, deployed source, acceptance); graph context is a fourth input there by definition. Move it to the SPEC side: spec_author consumes the BEB-2484 context_pack, and whatever it yields reaches codegen already inside SPEC.md. Remove the codegen-side fetch and its 30s timeout — it is paying for a call it discards.

## NOT MY CALL — the sandbox delta (m49270)
HOLD it, do not drop
